title: AES/ECB mode used in seal() — no semantic security or integrity protection
detail: src/aurora/aurora-identity/src/main/java/cloud/aurora/identity/CryptoUtil.java:L19 instantiates Cipher with 'AES/ECB/PKCS5Padding' in seal(); ECB mode produces identical ciphertext blocks for identical plaintext blocks, leaking data patterns, and provides no integrity protection.

title: AES/ECB mode used in open() — no semantic security or integrity protection
detail: src/aurora/aurora-identity/src/main/java/cloud/aurora/identity/CryptoUtil.java:L25 instantiates Cipher with 'AES/ECB/PKCS5Padding' in open(); ECB mode does not hide block patterns and allows an attacker to rearrange or replay ciphertext blocks without detection.
